## Summary

Thornfield Legal Ltd: fire damage in a neighbouring unit of a label printer and a barcode scanner at a storage unit on Mill Road. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 7,374 dollars.

## Facts

Thornfield Legal Ltd reported the loss on 19 March 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a storage unit on Mill Road [notice of loss]. The items are a label printer and a barcode scanner [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 21 March 2026 [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers theft of or damage to business contents in the insured's custody [policy]. Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: no theft is alleged [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 7,374 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,596 dollars and 2,778 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]; the schedule applies no excess [policy].
